form.name: Form 22, Application for Permit To Drill, Deepen or Re-enter
form.notes: Read the fillable PDF (fetched with WebFetch, text extracted with pdftotext; file last modified 4 Apr 2016, printed revision R 10/09). Cites ARM 36.22.307 and 36.22.601. Submitted in quadruplicate to the Billings office; no online filing found on the operator page. grade_reason: No bulk file or API with an approval date was verified. Approval dates are published only in weekly PDF letters (reachable, text-extractable, about 6 actions a week) and in the Dataminer Permits query, whose CSV export could not be driven here. The one machine-readable layer has status but no permit date. Could become A or B if the Dataminer export or the MT_MonthlyUpdate.zip proves to carry Dt Effect.
producer_plan: Best fragment today: the Weekly Activity Letters. Read the folder listing (one request), fetch each weekly PDF once (about 110 KB), extract text with pdftotext -layout, and walk the section headings. 'New Locations' and 'New Locations - Horizontal Wells' entries are new permits, 'Re-Issued Locations' are reissues, 'Expired Permits' carry Expired: dates, 'Abandoned Wells' entries also print Approved: but are plugging approvals and must not be counted as permits. An entry starts with county, field and API number (county-sequence, with a 5-digit number beside the well name) and ends with 'Approved: mm/dd/yyyy'; month = that date, not the letter's week. Counts are by date approved; no well class on new locations (horizontal vs other is the only split). Back-fill from 2016 by walking the folders. Better option to test first, in a browser or by a person: Dataminer Wells > Permits with the Csv export (one row per permit with Dt Effect, API, county, formation, slant, type, status), and the 5 Year Permit Count and Horizontal Permit Count pages for cross-checks; and the monthly zips. Caveats: the weekly letters are a layout-fragile PDF; the bogfiles host refused curl HEADs (403); the main host is blocked here; the Dataminer is an ASP.NET postback app, so a scripted run would need session and view-state handling and care not to hammer it.
privacy_notes: The letters and the layer name operators (companies in the pages read) and carry no phone numbers except the Board's own office. Form 22 collects an operator address and phone and a signing agent; the surface owner is not named on the form. Nothing copied.
